stem: Meera adds a few drops of iodine solution to a small piece of boiled potato in her school laboratory. The iodine turns blue-black. What does this result show?

options.text: The potato contains no nutrients at all.

teacher.key_rationale: Iodine solution turning blue-black is the standard positive result of the starch test, so the potato contains starch. Options B and C name nutrients detected by other tests (Biuret test for protein, emulsion/translucent spot test for fat), and D contradicts the positive result.
